scope: Retrospective F suspension state reconstruction only; no Prediction model integration or current-term F-count feature

initial_state.cohort: 617 distinct player registrations on 2017-01-01 brd_l3 entries, independently equal to Canonical race_entry cohort
initial_state.active_rule: A cohort player with a direct 2016-12-03 through 2016-12-31 brd_k3 chakujun=F result is ACTIVE_UNSERVED
initial_state.unresolved_rule: A cohort player without such a confirmed late-2016 K3 F remains UNRESOLVED; absence of a late F is not proof of CLEAR
initial_state.pre_2017_uncertainty_bound: Use 2016-12-31 as the last-possible-race anchor; no earlier unknown race is inferred to have cleared a state

state_machine.f_event: K3 chakujun=F, preserved in K3-only Canonical finish_raw/result_status
state_machine.prediction_time: All races on D use the same state after D-1; all D evidence is applied only after the last D prediction and first affects D+1
state_machine.clear_rule: Before D prediction, if D - last_possible_race_date >= 30 calendar days, CLEAR; 29 days ACTIVE, 30 and 31 days CLEAR
state_machine.active_regular_race: A confirmed race within 29 days keeps ACTIVE_UNSERVED and updates last race date after D
state_machine.additional_f: F during ACTIVE keeps ACTIVE; diagnostic F2 count increases, but one 30-day gap clears all pending F without a 60-day extension
state_machine.period_boundaries: No internal state reset on 05-01 or 11-01; current-term source F count is a separate feature
state_machine.initial_unresolved_resolution: A new K3 F confirms ACTIVE after D; a 30-day no-race gap on complete post-2017 history confirms CLEAR before D prediction
state_machine.missing_evidence: Retain UNRESOLVED when race participation or result leaves F status possible; never coerce unknown to CLEAR
state_machine.history_assumption: Project-authoritative assumption: nationwide participation and result history from 2017-01-01 onward is complete

prediction_feature_contract.current_term_f_count: separate feature; not developed or used in v1

formal_reconstruction.difference_from_k3_only_checkpoint: NONE; independent K3 seed rebuilt to the same 617/48/569 player states

evidence.direct_k3_vs_canonical: PASS; scope, seed, counts, prediction states, final states, first resolutions, and yearly F match exactly

version_rule: v1 is immutable after freeze; any method change requires v2
